text:
alex: Heads up — quick sync: microcopy in the Roles panel is confusing for new tenants, and telemetry doesn't tag routing/quota decisions. Can we clean both?
priya: Agree. Saw a support ticket where tenant thought 'scope' meant 'model scope' not route scope. Suggest: change label to 'Route scopes' + short tooltip :thinking:.
marcus: Also need to track which role eval triggered route fallback -> for cost debugging. Current audit logs only show route_id, not the role that allowed the fallback :eyes:.
sally: UX suggestion: expose small 'why this role applied' pill in the role detail flyout. One-liner + link to policy :thumbsup:.
alex: For implementers: internal API currently returns policies at `GET /admin/v1/roles?tenant=...` but the response flattens priorities. We should add an `eval_trace` field. Example:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  "https://api.redwood.internal/admin/v1/roles?tenant=acme"
```
```json
{
  "roles": [ { "id": "r_123", "name": "TenantAdmin", "scopes": [...], "priority": 10, "eval_trace": { "matched_scope": "route:/generate", "matched_rule": "allow-route", "reason": "explicit match" } } ]
}
```
priya: `eval_trace` makes sense. Keep it compact — don't send full policy blobs for every row. Maybe a delta + id ref.
marcus: Backend note: adding `eval_trace` will change RBAC cache size. We should only populate when `?include=eval_trace` query param is present to avoid payload blowup. Also consider a batch endpoint for multiple routes.
alex: SG. For telemetry, we need event keys: `role_id`, `role_name`, `matched_scope`, `route_affinity`, `quota_decision`. Proposed event name: `rbac.role_eval`. Minimal example payload:
```json
{ "event": "rbac.role_eval", "tenant": "acme", "route": "/generate", "role_id": "r_123", "matched_scope": "route:/generate", "route_affinity": "primary", "quota_decision": "buckets/standard" }
```
sally: Can we surface a small graph in Console under route debug that shows "requests -> matched role -> quota bucket"? Maybe a lightweight sparkline and the last 24h counts :chart_with_upwards_trend:.
priya: Rollout plan: feature flag `rbac-ui-trace` for console + `rbac.trace_api` for API. Canary to 10% tenants for 48h, then 50% for a week, then GA. Also add a sampling mode so telemetry only emits 1% by default.
deploy-bot: deploy 4778901240 by priya - canary: 10% prod - succeeded
marcus: API naming nit: `eval_trace` vs `decision_trace`. Prefer `eval_trace` to match other service fields (model evals).
alex: fine. priya can you update the design doc and the telemetry PR? Link: https://redwood.internal/designs/rbac-eval-trace
priya: On it. I'll also add microcopy: "Route scopes (which routes this role can access)" and a hover example. I'll open PR for console copy + flag. ETA EOD :ok_hand:.
sally: If you need a short UX test i'll drop a quick Maze link and ping support for a couple customers to try the wording :email:.
